title: Remote Support Specialist Associate
description:
Overview

At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people’s lives every day. We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

As a global leader in food processing and packaging, Tetra Pak delivers cutting-edge solutions that ensure food safety and quality across the globe. Our success is driven not only by our advanced technologies, but also by the people behind them—professionals who are passionate about innovation and committed to protecting what’s good. Within our global Services organization, the Remote Support Hub is a key part of Next Generation Service Operations, providing 24/7 technical support to customers in over 160 countries.

As a Remote Support Specialist Associate , you will join a team of experts who resolve the most complex and critical cases escalated from our customers’ production sites. Working closely with senior specialists, you will learn how to diagnose and solve advanced automation and equipment issues using industry-leading digital tools and methodologies in the food and beverage industry, helping customers keep their high-speed production lines running efficiently. This position offers a unique opportunity to learn how our equipment and automation systems operate as a whole, combining mechanical and digital components to deliver reliable performance. You will be trained in our automation platforms and programming tools, and gradually take on more responsibility as you grow.

You will interact remotely with customers and internal teams, gaining exposure to global best practices and contributing to solutions that keep food safe and available everywhere. As part of Tetra Pak’s Next Generation strategy, you will be empowered to learn, collaborate, and make a difference from day one, building the foundation for a successful career in a dynamic, innovative, and customer-focused organization. The role is designed for recent graduates with a background in mechatronics, automation, or IT who are curious, hands-on, and eager to understand how industrial systems work in practice. You will interact remotely with customers and internal teams, gaining exposure to real-world challenges and contributing to solutions that have a direct impact on food production around the world. This is a development position, and we are looking for individuals who want to build their careers by learning, collaborating, and making a difference.

This position will be based in Monte Mor, SP. Tetra Pak does not offer visa or relocation support for this position.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to underrepresented or minorized groups, including women, Black, Indigenous, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, and others.

What you will do

As a Remote Support Specialist Associate, you will:

  • Participate in the remote resolution of complex automation cases via phone, chat, and email for customers and Tetra Pak field teams;
  • Lead remote troubleshooting sessions, document solutions, and ensure customer satisfaction before closing support cases;
  • Collaborate with field engineers and global competence networks to share knowledge and drive continuous improvement;
  • Support initiatives to enhance equipment reliability, availability, and performance;
  • Continuously develop your technical and problem-solving skills through training and project participation.

We believe you have

  • Recent graduate in Mechatronics, Automation, IT, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields;

title: Artistic Director
description:
Overview

VRAI is one of the fastest-growing digital-first direct-to-consumer brands. Modernizing diamond jewelry through the exclusive use of sustainably created diamonds, VRAI has innovation, craftsmanship, and sustainability at the core of its products and values. An honoree of Fast Co. Innovation Award in retail design, VRAI is a global brand with locations in Los Angeles, San Francisco, NY, Shanghai, Chicago, London, Madrid, and Copenhagen, with more locations on the horizon.

As Artistic Director at VRAI, you will be responsible for leading and shaping the artistic cohesion and direction of all marketing, including social (IG, TikTok), email, retail stores, and advertising. You will work with a small team to create compelling content and objects that align with our brand and resonate with our audience. This role requires a keen eye for detail, a strong sense of aesthetics, and the ability to translate concepts into impactful visual stories.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the artistic cohesion and direction of all marketing, ensuring a consistent consumer experience and an elevated sense of timeless luxury.
  • Lead and manage a creative team, providing guidance and feedback to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and sales teams to create cohesive and compelling campaigns.
  • Oversee the production of all content and objects, including photography, videography, graphic design & CGI, as well as window and other displays in VRAI’s retail stores.
  • Manage relationships with external agencies, photographers, videographers, models, stylists and other creative partners.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a creative leadership role, preferably within non-fashion luxury.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing a range of creative projects and a keen sense of aesthetic judgment.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and project management skills.

Compensation

$80,000 - $140,000 a year. Actual compensation may be higher or lower in the range based on various factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate’s job duties, experience, expertise, and location. We will also consider higher-level candidates and salary will be adjusted accordingly.

Benefits

Overview

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to take ownership of our data infrastructure, designing and optimizing high-performance, scalable solutions. You’ll work with AWS and big data frameworks like Hadoop and Spark to drive impactful data initiatives across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain large-scale data pipelines and data processing systems in AWS.
  • Develop and optimize distributed data workflows using Hadoop, Spark, and related technologies.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to deliver reliable and efficient data solutions.
  • Implement best practices for data governance, security, and compliance.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve the performance of data systems and pipelines.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to building a culture of technical excellence.
  • Evaluate and recommend new tools, frameworks, and approaches for data engineering.

Must Haves

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related roles
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS services (S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, etc.)
  • Deep knowledge of big data ecosystems including Hadoop (HDFS, Hive, MapReduce) and Apache Spark (PySpark, Spark SQL, streaming)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing and automation

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in fast-paced environments
  • Ability to work in the German Time Zone (approximately 6-7 am to 2-3 pm Brazil/ART time)
  • Upper-Intermediate English level

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time data streaming platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink)
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and catalog tools
  • Previous leadership or mentoring experience

Perks and Benefits

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based compensation with budgets for education, fitness, and team activities
  • A selection of exciting projects: Projects with modern solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands
  • Flextime: Options for working from home or office to support work-life balance

  • Mid-Senior level
